transcript: Gypsy remains one of the greatest musicals ever written. Like, there is a reason why we get a new production every 10 years, and I am happy to say that this production keeps that legacy alive by delivering a production that feels both like the classic Gypsy that you know and love, but also reinvents it in ways that makes it feel new and fresh. And a lot of this is due to the casting philosophy of this production, which is very thoughtful about the races of each character and what that can bring to their characterization. So not only do we get our first black Mama Rose, at least on Broadway, but June and Louise are also black, with June being more light skinned and white passing than Louise's, which gives a whole new layer to why June is favored over Louise. And under this new lens, a lot of those lines hit very differently. Like suddenly, Louise being asked to cover her face and put on a cow costume, while her white passing sister and her all white backup dancers get the spotlight. That reads very differently now. And I just love when a revival is able to make you see the characters and the story in a new light without changing a word. And yet the actual staging itself feels very traditional. It feels very similar to the Hello, Dolly revival, which, ironically, was also designed by Santa Loquasto, in that they know that you have a Set expectation of what a Gypsy revival should look like, and rather than reinvent the wheel, they're just going to give you a perfectly executed version of that. I also thought on hold, the performances were really great across the board. Obviously Audra is great. I made a whole video praising her performance, but the entire supporting cast is delivering a really stellar performances. There were some elements of the performances that I thought needed a little bit more time to develop, but given that it was first preview, I am not going to judge them too harshly, and I don't think anyone else who was there should either. It is only going to get tighter as the run goes on, so I'm personally really not worried. I think the show is in a really excellent shape, and it is really everything that I wanted it to be. It is a truly stunning and lavish Gypsy revival featuring some stellar performances and, of course, one of our greatest living actresses just giving an absolute master class of her performance.
reasoning: Creator saw first preview and delivers enthusiastic praise for the revival's thoughtful casting, traditional staging, and stellar performances, calling it everything they wanted it to be.
